title: AR23205: Photography, Art And Advanced Visual Communication
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Advanced exercises for fine arts – pencil and charcoal sketching, mixed media
rendering, water colour compositions and primary use of acrylic/oil colours;
alternative media work such as glass painting, earthen pot painting; Advanced
aspects of visual cognition, psychological responses of humans; Art, design,
architecture and cinema appreciation; Image doctoring and manipulation using
computer software for graphics and animation (Photoshop and Flash).
Study of the fundamentals of still photography and the camera – Lens types,
Aperture and exposure, shutter speed, depth of field, focus, light conditions,
light compensation; Comparative assessment of traditional SLR and digital
photography. Basic movie camera shooting, traditional analog and digital
methods, conversion of analog to digital, memory manipulation and software
compatibility exercises; Elementary film editing – video and audio clips,
merging, morphing, transitions (with Adobe Premiere).
